caption: The app found R980 a month leaking out on things I'd forgotten I was paying for. What's hiding in yours?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R24 500
p/m salary
Living in East London
slides.body:
Female, 27
Single, lives alone
Job: Marketing coordinator
Net salary: R24 500 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: 1 bed in Bunkers Hill, water, refuse
slides.body: I got a raise in January and moved somewhere I could actually park.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Woolworths mostly, Checkers when I'm being sensible
slides.body: I know exactly which shop costs more. I go there anyway.

slides.title: Car instalment
slides.body: The most boring line on this list, and the one I never think about.

slides.title: Subscriptions & streaming
slides.includes: Four streaming apps, a gym I haven't been to since March, one app I didn't recognise the name of
slides.body: I thought this was maybe R300. It's R980, and one of those is a subscription I have never used.

slides.title: Delivery & takeaways
slides.body: It's not the amount that gets me, it's how many separate orders it takes to reach it.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Petrol & insurance, phone & fibre, medical aid, funeral policy, stokvel, electricity, clothing account
slides.body: R7 500 that I could mostly describe without looking, which is worse than not knowing.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R24 500. The raise was supposed to change this number. It moved it by about R400.

slides.title: The app found what I couldn't see
slides.body:
I uploaded three months of statements to Beyond Horizon and it flagged the subscriptions on its own.

One of them I genuinely didn't recognise until I saw the merchant name.

No bank login needed.
